Clinical Research Article

Authors
A. Researcher, B. Scientist, C. Investigator

Affiliation
Department of Clinical Research, Tianjin Beichen Hospital, Tianjin, China

Abstract

This retrospective human study evaluated clinical outcomes in patients treated at a single hospital.

Methods

This single-center retrospective study included 120 patients treated at Tianjin Beichen Hospital.

The study was approved by the Ethics Committee of Tianjin Beichen Hospital (Approval No. SYN-2026-001).

Due to the retrospective design, the requirement for informed consent was waived by the Ethics Committee.

All procedures performed in this study were in accordance with the ethical standards of the institutional research committee and with the Declaration of Helsinki and its later amendments.

Results

A total of 120 patients were included in the final analysis.

Data Availability

The data analyzed during this study are available from the corresponding author on reasonable request.
